title: LLM Integration Module
summary: This module provides abstract and concrete implementations for integrating with various Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Anthropic, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, and OpenAI-compatible services. It handles message formatting, tool calling, streaming, and token usage tracking for diverse LLM providers.

nodes.label: Abstract LLM Interface
nodes.title: Abstract LLM Interface
nodes.description: Defines the foundational contract for all LLM integrations, managing common functionalities like message handling, event dispatch, and token metrics, ensuring consistent interaction patterns across diverse providers.

nodes.label: Anthropic LLM Integration
nodes.title: Anthropic LLM Integration
nodes.description: Connects to Anthropic's API to enable Claude models, supporting native tool use, streaming, and specific message formats, while handling authentication and error reporting.

nodes.label: Azure AI LLM Integration
nodes.title: Azure AI LLM Integration
nodes.description: Manages connections to Azure AI Inference endpoints, handling Azure-specific authentication, tool calling, and streaming for various Azure-hosted models, including Azure OpenAI.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock LLM Integration
nodes.title: AWS Bedrock LLM Integration
nodes.description: Provides integration with AWS Bedrock's Converse API, supporting tool calling, streaming, guardrails, and model-specific configurations, with robust error handling for AWS services.

nodes.label: Google Gemini LLM Integration
nodes.title: Google Gemini LLM Integration
nodes.description: Facilitates integration with Google Gemini models via the Gen AI Python SDK, enabling function calling, streaming, and Vertex AI configurations, with careful management of authentication.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible LLM Integration
nodes.title: OpenAI-Compatible LLM Integration
nodes.description: Extends OpenAI integration to support diverse compatible APIs (e.g., OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama) by dynamically configuring base URLs and API keys for seamless interoperability.

nodes.label: Anthropic LLM Service
nodes.title: Anthropic LLM Service
nodes.description: External API providing Large Language Model capabilities from Anthropic, used for generating text and handling tool calls.

nodes.label: Azure AI Inference Service
nodes.title: Azure AI Inference Service
nodes.description: External API providing Large Language Model capabilities from Azure AI, including advanced inference features and structured output.

nodes.label: AWS Bedrock LLM Service
nodes.title: AWS Bedrock LLM Service
nodes.description: External API providing Large Language Model capabilities from AWS Bedrock, supporting Converse API for unified model interaction.

nodes.label: Google Gen AI Service
nodes.title: Google Gen AI Service
nodes.description: External API providing Large Language Model capabilities from Google, including Gemini models and Vertex AI services.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible LLM Services
nodes.title: OpenAI-Compatible LLM Services
nodes.description: Various external API services that adhere to the OpenAI API specification, allowing flexible integration with different LLM providers.

nodes.label: Dispatch CrewAI Events
nodes.title: Dispatch CrewAI Events
nodes.description: Internal system for broadcasting and managing events related to LLM operations and tool interactions, enabling observability and custom reactions within the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: Execute LLM Call Hooks
nodes.title: Execute LLM Call Hooks
nodes.description: Provides a mechanism to inject and run custom logic before and after interactions with LLM providers, allowing for pre-processing or post-processing of calls.

nodes.label: Convert Tool Definitions
nodes.title: Convert Tool Definitions
nodes.description: Utility to transform generic tool specifications into the specific formats required by different LLM providers, ensuring compatibility and correct function calling.

nodes.label: Validate Structured Output
nodes.title: Validate Structured Output
nodes.description: Component for validating and parsing LLM-generated structured data against predefined Pydantic models, ensuring output adheres to expected schemas.

nodes.label: Manage Multimodal Files
nodes.title: Manage Multimodal Files
nodes.description: Facilitates the upload and proper formatting of files (images, documents) for multimodal LLM inputs, adapting to provider-specific requirements.

nodes.label: Format LLM Messages
nodes.title: Format LLM Messages
nodes.description: Standardizes and adapts conversational messages into the internal LLMMessage format and then into provider-specific API formats for consistent interaction.

nodes.label: Track Token Usage
nodes.title: Track Token Usage
nodes.description: Monitors and aggregates token consumption metrics for all interactions with integrated LLMs, providing insights into cost and efficiency.

nodes.label: Determine Context Window
nodes.title: Determine Context Window
nodes.description: Provides model-specific information regarding the maximum input token capacity for LLMs, aiding in prompt construction and preventing overflow errors.

nodes.label: OpenAI LLM Integration Base
nodes.title: OpenAI LLM Integration Base
nodes.description: Foundational class for integrating with OpenAI's API, handling core OpenAI-specific logic and serving as a base for compatible providers.

groups.label: LLM Abstraction Layer
groups.title: LLM Abstraction Layer
groups.description: The core abstract interface that defines common behaviors and properties for all LLM integrations, ensuring consistency across different providers.

groups.label: Provider-Specific Integrations
groups.title: Provider-Specific Integrations
groups.description: Concrete implementations for integrating with various LLM providers, each handling the unique API requirements, authentication, and features of their respective services.

groups.label: Internal LLM Utilities
groups.title: Internal LLM Utilities
groups.description: A collection of internal components that support and enhance the functionality of LLM integrations, including event handling, data formatting, and performance tracking.

groups.label: External LLM Services
groups.title: External LLM Services
groups.description: The external Large Language Model APIs that the module integrates with, representing the actual AI services providing generative capabilities.
